verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting SaaS with a documented REST API, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers webhooks and the axis applies. The evidence covers the API, an OpenAPI spec, a sandbox and an MCP server, but none of it documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The request-based API and MCP tools are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
